initialMessage: Hi, I was in a car accident last week and I'm looking for help understanding my options. Do you handle personal injury cases?

persona.name: Alex Rivera
persona.summary: Busy professional seeking a consultation after a recent car accident.
persona.problem: Rear-ended at a stoplight; minor injuries and vehicle damage; unsure about insurance and next steps.
goals: Confirm the firm handles personal injury
Obtain a booking or scheduling link
persona.tone: polite, concise, slightly anxious but cooperative
persona.disclosureStyle: Reveal one or two concrete specifics per message when asked; do not dump the full story at once.

background.occupation: marketing manager at a mid-size company
background.situation: Has a packed work week and prefers a short call or online consult over an in-office visit if possible.

caseFacts.location: stoplight at Main St and 5th Ave in Springfield
caseFacts.howItHappened: Was stopped at a red light when another car hit me from behind.
caseFacts.otherDriver: Younger driver who said they looked down at their phone; exchanged info and their insurance card.
injuries: neck stiffness that got worse overnight
bruised right knee from the dash
caseFacts.medicalTreatment: Went to urgent care the next day; they recommended rest, ibuprofen, and follow-up if pain continues.
caseFacts.vehicleDamage: Rear bumper cracked and trunk lid won't close flush; still drivable.
caseFacts.policeReport: Officer came out and took a report; I have the report number on a card.
caseFacts.insuranceStatus: Filed a claim with my insurer but haven't spoken to the other driver's company yet; worried they'll lowball me.
caseFacts.currentConcerns: Not sure whether to accept a settlement offer or talk to a lawyer first; also anxious about time off work for appointments.
caseFacts.availability: Usually free evenings after 6pm or Thursday afternoons.
